articles.title: Who’s to blame in the Shohei Ohtani injury saga? Everyone

articles.title: Dodgers’ September roster: Breaking down the call-up decisions
articles.description: As they looked to put their August woes firmly in the rear-view mirror, the Dodgers opened September with a series of roster tweaks.
